monotonicCursor.evidence: The writer increments chats.stream_seq and reads the updated head into each insert in one ordered db.batch transaction (packages/server/src/domain/chat/persistence/stream-events.ts:35-65). The focused regression deletes the latest message and observes the next replay row at seq 3 (tests/server/domain/chat/persistence/stream-events.int.test.ts:24-58).

concurrentWritersAndRollback.evidence: The repository concurrency test passed. An independent real-libSQL stress probe launched 16 concurrent one-row batches and observed exactly seq 1..16. A second probe forced the second insert in a two-delta batch to collide on id; the batch rejected with zero rows and chats.stream_seq restored to 0.

generationIdentityAndReplay.evidence: One fresh generation id is minted per append-builder invocation and shared only across that invocation's deltas (packages/server/src/domain/chat/persistence/stream-events.ts:35-40,54-59). The engine invokes it inside each commit attempt using the slot selected by new-slot/swipe/continue (packages/server/src/domain/chat/engine/engine.ts:637-645). Replay selects generation_id, and member scrubbing keys state by generation id with message-id fallback only for legacy null rows (packages/server/src/domain/chat/substrate/member-visibility.ts:346-385). The prior same-message '<li'/'teral public' counterexample returned only 'teral public'. A legacy-null truncated hidden span returned no rows and exposed no SECRET bytes.

attributionVisibilityAndKinds.evidence: Delta chat attribution is rejected before statement construction, while message/chat coherence is re-derived by scalar subqueries inside the transaction (packages/server/src/domain/chat/persistence/stream-events.ts:41-59). The schema retains the per-chat seq uniqueness, message cascade/index, and text|reasoning CHECK (packages/db/src/schema/chat.ts:935-964). Focused persistence, member-visibility, engine, and read-verb suites passed.

migration.evidence: 0003 adds nullable generation_id, adds non-null stream_seq default 0, and backfills it from per-chat MAX(seq) with empty chats at 0 (packages/db/src/migrations/0003_chat_stream_cursor_generation.sql:1-7). An independent pre-0003 in-memory fixture produced heads a=9, b=4, empty=0. Snapshot 0003 points to snapshot 0002 and contains both columns; drizzle chain and baseline parity checks passed.

verification.result: PASS: live schema matches the four-migration chain ending at 0003

independentProbes: 16 concurrent real-libSQL append batches allocated exactly [1..16]
a two-delta batch failing on its second insert rolled back both cursor increments and the first inserted row
the exact same-message generation scrubber counterexample no longer combined '<li' with 'teral public'
legacy null generation state withheld a truncated hidden span and leaked no hidden bytes
the 0003 SQL backfilled multiple populated chats to their independent maximum seq and an empty chat to zero
limitations: No broad repository suite was run; the requested focused behavior, its read seam, three affected native type programs, and both migration checks were exercised.
